flow: 4 November 2026: every human input is taken once, at the start. A one-off goal plans, asks only what it could not find, agrees the deliverables and the template for each, then runs to the end by itself: findings accepted automatically, the top option chosen automatically, the deliverables built. A standing goal agrees the same at set-up plus the actions it may take; when it fires it runs, chooses, acts, builds and tells you. Anything can be changed afterwards; the deliverables are rebuilt as the next version.

panelTabs.rule: Always the same six tabs in the same order, from the first message to the last. A tab with nothing in it yet says what will land there. The panel opens on the tab that matters at that moment (Plan while briefing, Workflow while it runs, Deliverables when it is done); the order never changes.

contents.plan: Open points (Missing in orange until answered, then Clarified in green with the answer and where it came from), then the plan rows and the deliverables agreed
contents.workflow: The steps as a graph; a "working now" card per running step with its calls one by one, a progress bar and the seconds elapsed
contents.findings: Every finding (tagged "Accepted automatically"), its evidence and data, and all the options with "Why this" and "Use this instead". On a standing goal also the runs and the actions with their states
contents.deliverables: The deliverables, built part by part in front of you (a chip per deliverable: done, being built, waiting), then complete; download or open in Submissions

stages.reading: The agent reads what it was given and what is connected (about twenty seconds at normal pace). The feed in the chat shows one tool call per line; each line reveals plan rows. The composer is off. Ends with the steps drafted.
stages.questions: Your input, all of it in one step. Only what the reads could not find, one card at a time (kind 'q'); each answered point turns from Missing to Clarified on the Plan tab. Then the deliverables card (kind 'deliv'): the deliverables the goal suggests, ticked, and more offered unticked; add your own in words; for each the template, Recommended, From the library, Upload your own or Create one for me. A standing goal's card also sets each kind of action to By itself or Ask me first. One click: Run it, or Arm the watch.
stages.running: (once) No second agreement and no checkpoint. Steps run (about ten seconds each); findings land as steps finish; then findings accepted automatically (over['acc:<id>'] = 'auto'), the top option chosen automatically (chosenBy 'auto'), the deliverables built part by part (prog: {sids, i, shown}). Status 'delivered'; the goal moves to Executed.
stages.armed: (watch) Armed. Nothing runs until the rule fires or the schedule is due ("Simulate tonight’s load" or 'Simulate: run now' in the demo). On firing: a notification; status 'fired' while the steps run; then accept, choose, build and act by themselves: actions set to By itself are done, the others wait (state 'waiting') under Needs you until Approve or Leave it. Status 'executed'; a notification says what it found, what it chose and what it did. The watch stays armed.
stages.after: Look back, change anything: 'Use this instead' on another option, or a steer in the chat ("Leave Corrigan out of ferric": step 3 and everything after it re-run). Every deliverable is rebuilt as the next version (version, basis; the earlier version stays in the log). On a standing goal, what was done stays done and the new option's actions wait for your OK.

statusNotes.ready: only a goal with no recorded analysis: the run ends on a question and nothing is built
statusNotes.executed: standing goal run handled (actions done or waiting)

templateModes.recommended: Recommended (the agent picks from the library)
templateModes.upload: Upload your own (read into a "Your file" template)
templateModes.ai: Create one for me (the agent designs the structure from your words)

deliverables.spec: DelivSpec: id, label, audience, purpose, why, format, on, mode, recId, templateId, describe, uploadName, custom

journeyBarRule.input: stage questions or plan (sub: answered of total, the deliverables card counts as one)
journeyBarRule.run: once: status running; watch: status fired or executing (sub: done of N)
journeyBarRule.handled: watch: status executed (sub: n for your OK while actions wait)

notifications.toast: Top right, with a call to action (Watch it run, Open it, Review it)
notifications.bell: Every notice stays in the bell drawer; unread count on the bell

dock: While the card waiting for you is scrolled out of sight, a bar docks above the message box ('Pick the deliverables, then run it', 'Approve or leave the held action'), with 'Go to it'.
resumeLine: Reopening a goal with history shows one line: 'Back on this. Step n of N, <label>. Next: <what it needs>.' or, when done, that the deliverables are on the right.

listGroups.Needs you: goals being briefed (questions or the deliverables card open), and standing-goal runs with an action waiting for your OK
listGroups.Running: one-off goals running, standing goals firing
listGroups.Standing goals: every armed watch, with "Simulate tonight’s load" / 'Simulate: run now'
listGroups.Executed: one-off goals delivered and standing-goal runs handled, each with its deliverables
listGroups.Saved plans: saved plans with 'new goal from it'

timings.pace: Every delay is multiplied by ?pace= in the address (default 1; 0.05 runs twenty times faster). A virtual clock (?clock=ISO) makes the times shown deterministic.
timings.reading: About twenty seconds of read lines before the first question; each next question after a short pause
onceRun: n1 done, F1 lands, n2 and n3 running
n4 done, F4 lands, n5 running
watchRun: w1 done, W1 lands, w2 and w3 running
w3 done, W3 lands, w4 running
steerRerun: n3 done again (contentKey n3b), F3 → F3b
timings.measured: At normal pace: the one-off example about 75 seconds from Run it to delivered (about 50 of steps, 25 of building); the watch about 65 seconds from firing to handled; a deliverable made in Submissions about 16 seconds.

controls.Tiles on a question card: answer the open point; the Plan tab shows it Clarified with the answer and its source
controls.Deliverables card: tick or untick; add your own in words with a format; for each the template mode; on a standing goal By itself / Ask me first per kind of action; Run it / Arm the watch
controls.Use this instead: on another option under Findings: chosenBy you, every deliverable rebuilt as the next version; on a standing goal the new option's actions wait for your OK
controls.Steer chip: 'Leave Corrigan out of ferric' → diff card → Apply: step 3 stale then done (n3b), F3 → F3b, the steps after it re-done, the saving moves to $3.21M a year (6.1%) with ferric chloride to Sabine Coast alone, the option chosen goes back to the top one and every deliverable is rebuilt on it
controls.Approve / Leave it: on a held action, from the Deliverables tab or the chat
controls.Make more deliverables in Submissions: opens Submissions on this analysis with the make card
controls.Save this plan: adds a saved plan to the list
controls.Simulate: fires the rule (the load of 28 October 02:00) or runs the schedule now
